subject: Cardinal HealthTech — security triage & questionnaire kickoff
messages:
From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna@cardinalht.com>, security@cardinalht.com
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Cardinal HealthTech — security triage & questionnaire kickoff

Hi Anna / Cardinal security team,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — good to hear more about the telemetry and regulated-data patterns you’re seeing. Per our call, I wanted to capture a short kickoff note so your security and procurement teams have a single place to review next steps.

Summary from call:
- Cardinal is evaluating Redwood for a mixed-hosting deployment (hosted API for public-facing conversational features + VPC for PHI workflows).
- Key compliance asks: SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months), HIPAA BAA requirement for PHI path, and GDPR data residency considerations for EU subsystems.
- Cardinal prefers a rapid security intake to unblock procurement but may need an NDA/POC agreement first.

Questions we need clarified to scope the questionnaire and evidence bundle:
1) Hosting residency: any EU-only residency required for the first phase? If yes, which services/paths need to stay in-region?
2) PHI scope: will Cardinal route PHI through the hosted API or only via the VPC/on-prem option? This affects the BAA and SOC evidence we surface.
3) Level of questionnaire: do you want the full SIG / CAIQ matrix or a condensed SIG-Lite/CAIQ-lite prefill + targeted evidence?
4) Timeline: what is your target decision date for security sign-off (procurement timeline)?

Attached is a short spreadsheet template to capture owners and the preliminary scope (Cardinal_initial_scope.xlsx). Marissa (cc) will be our security lead on evidence collection. Ben will support any procurement/contracting questions.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm answers to the four bullets above (reply inline).
- If helpful, schedule a 30-min scoping call next week with Marissa to walk the SIG fields and evidence owners.
- We’ll return a suggested prefill (SIG/CAIQ or lite) and an evidence checklist within 2 business days of scoping confirmation.

Thanks — happy to hop on another quick call to get this moving.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Anna Lopez <anna@cardinalht.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@cardinalht.com, procurement@cardinalht.com
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 13:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cardinal HealthTech — security triage & questionnaire kickoff

Jonas — thanks for the writeup, this is helpful. A few quick answers and context from our side:

1) Residency: for phase 1 we need EU resident storage only for our patient-facing analytics datastore. The conversational front-end can remain US-hosted.
2) PHI: PHI will only be processed via our private VPC path for now; the hosted API will be explicitly non-PHI.
3) Questionnaire level: procurement prefers a CAIQ-lite prefill + a short evidence bundle initially; security would like the option to request the full SIG if gaps surface.
4) Timeline: target procurement decision is Mar 15, 2027 — security sign-off ideally by Mar 1 to allow contracting time.

We attached our initial scope worksheet (Cardinal_initial_scope.xlsx) with internal owners filled in — security@cardinalht.com owns evidence consolidation. Procurement also asked whether you can provide a recent SOC 2 Type II report and a BAA template.

Can you also confirm whether Redwood supports HSM-backed KMS for private deployments? If so, please indicate which cloud KMS integrations are supported (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault).

Appreciate it — I’ll loop in procurement for any NDA/PO paperwork we need to share.

Thanks,
Anna
Director of Security Operations
Cardinal HealthTech

[Attachment: Cardinal_initial_scope.xlsx]

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna@cardinalht.com>, security@cardinalht.com
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cardinal HealthTech — security triage & questionnaire kickoff

Anna — great, thanks for the quick clarifications and the filled worksheet. A few follow-ups and what we’ll deliver next:

- Residency & PHI: noted — we’ll mark EU datastore as "in-scope" for residency evidence and VPC flow as PHI-handling path. That means for the initial submission we will: provide our SOC 2 Type II report, a redacted network diagram for the VPC deployment, and our standard BAA template.
- CAIQ vs SIG: we’ll prepare a CAIQ-lite prefill + an evidence bundle, and we’ll keep the full SIG in reserve if you elect to expand the review.
- KMS/HSM: Redwood Private supports HSM-backed KMS integrations. Supported cloud key providers: AWS KMS (CloudHSM), GCP KMS, and Azure Key Vault. We’ll include a KMS integration matrix in the evidence bundle.

Attached: redwood-evidence-checklist.pdf (mapping of suggested deliverables to Cardinal's worksheet).

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
- Feb 22: Redwood delivers CAIQ-lite prefill + evidence checklist (we’ll do this by EOD).
- Feb 24–26: Cardinal reviews prefill, flags gaps; schedule 30-min scoping call if needed.
- Mar 1: Security sign-off target (per your timeline).
- Mar 5–12: Contracting / BAA finalization.

If that timeline looks off, tell us where to reshape — otherwise Marissa will send a calendar invite for a short scoping call Thursday or Friday this week.

Best,
Jonas
